{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after stripping commas
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify premises
assert df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "'converted' is not binary"
assert (df['customer_age'] >= -1).all(), "'customer_age' has values below -1"
assert (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum() == 108, "Expected 108 missing ages (value -1)"

# Check for QA orders
qa_count = (df['revenue'] == 999999.99).sum()
print(f"QA orders: {qa_count}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"Refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = df[df['converted'] == 1]
print(f"Total converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}")

# Filter out those with missing age (age == -1)
valid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]
print(f"Converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_age_converted)}")

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding missing age): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")"}
